local companies = tool('list_companies')
local domain_to_company = {}
for _, c in ipairs(companies) do
  domain_to_company[(c.domain or ''):lower()] = c.name
end

local valid_pattern = '^%+1' .. string.rep('%d', 10) .. '$'
local phones_fixed, companies_filled = 0, 0
local changes, skipped = {}, {}

local page = 1
local total_pages = 1
repeat
  local r = tool('list_contacts', { page = page })
  total_pages = r.total_pages
  for _, ct in ipairs(r.items) do
    local update = { id = ct.id }
    local changed = false

    -- (1) phone -> E.164 (US: +1 + 10 digits)
    local ph = ct.phone or ''
    if not ph:match(valid_pattern) then
      local digits = ph:gsub('%D', '')
      local newph
      if #digits == 10 then
        newph = '+1' .. digits
      elseif #digits == 11 and digits:sub(1, 1) == '1' then
        newph = '+1' .. digits:sub(2)
      end
      if newph then
        update.phone = newph
        phones_fixed = phones_fixed + 1
        changed = true
      else
        skipped[#skipped + 1] = { id = ct.id, phone = ct.phone, reason = 'not a 10/11-digit US number' }
      end
    end

    -- (2) fill empty company from email domain
    if ct.company == nil or ct.company == '' then
      local domain = (ct.email or ''):match('@(.+)$')
      if domain then
        local name = domain_to_company[domain:lower()]
        if name then
          update.company = name
          companies_filled = companies_filled + 1
          changed = true
        else
          skipped[#skipped + 1] = { id = ct.id, email = ct.email, reason = 'no company for domain' }
        end
      end
    end

    if changed then
      tool('update_contact', update)
      changes[#changes + 1] = { id = ct.id, name = ct.name, phone_before = ct.phone, company_before = ct.company, update = update }
    end
  end
  page = page + 1
until page > total_pages

return { phones_fixed = phones_fixed, companies_filled = companies_filled, changes = changes, skipped = skipped, company_domains = domain_to_company }
